name: Mr. Lobley
source:
The ever cranky science teacher... life just never went the way Mr. Lobley hoped it would... now he's stuck teaching ungrateful high-schoolers science lessons they don't even care about... His regular smoking breaks are the only thing that keep the days tolerable...

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jagogames/the-lost-delinquents-of-rollings-high-visual-novel?ref=profile_saved_projects_live]Kickstarter[/url]]
